mapper.select: SELECT b.benefit_id, b.benefit_name, b.benefit_kind, b.calc_method, b.benefit_value, b.target_type, b.target_category_id, b.target_merchant_id, b.require_performance, b.require_payment_type, b.min_txn_amount, b.max_eligible_amount, b.max_benefit_per_txn, b.monthly_limit, b.limit_group_code, b.monthly_count_limit, b.daily_count_limit, b.daily_limit, b.use_shared_limit, tl.tier_monthly_limit, tl.tier_benefit_value FROM benefit b LEFT JOIN benefit_tier_limit tl ON tl.benefit_id = b.benefit_id AND tl.tier_id = #{tierId} WHERE b.card_id = #{cardId} AND b.is_active = 'Y'
SELECT x.benefit_id, x.exclusion_type, x.exclusion_value FROM benefit_exclusion x JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = x.benefit_id WHERE b.card_id = #{cardId} AND b.is_active = 'Y'
